The 'cutaway' view reveals nonsensical internal geometry that doesn't correspond to real speaker engineering.

The surfaces have an overly glossy, 'melted' plastic appearance. The transition between the solid chassis and the 'internal' components is blurry and lacks sharp, manufactured edges typical of real electronics.

The circular driver on the right side appears slightly elliptical and warped, inconsistent with the perspective of the rest of the boxy structure. The orange ring around it bleeds slightly into the surrounding black material.
